learning_objective: 🎯 [Kids will learn how to write a well-structured short paragraph and a simple leave application to their school principal.]
warm_up_hook: ✍️ Do you have a fun story in your head or a message you need to share? Writing is like painting a picture using words! Let's learn how to build perfect paragraphs and write formal letters like a pro.

lesson_modules.teaching_content: A paragraph is a group of sentences about ONE main idea. It has three parts: a beginning (Topic Sentence that introduces the idea), the middle (Detail Sentences that tell us more), and an ending (Closing Sentence to finish it nicely).
examples_or_templates: Beginning: I have a pet dog named Bruno.
Middle: He is brown and very fluffy. He loves to play fetch.
Ending: He is my best friend and I love him very much.

lesson_modules.module_title: 🏫 The Leave Application (अवकाश के लिए प्रार्थना पत्र)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: Sometimes we fall sick or have an urgent work, so we cannot go to school. We must write a polite letter called an 'Application' to the Principal to ask for a leave.
examples_or_templates: Start with: To, The Principal, [School Name], [City]
Add Date and Subject: Application for Sick Leave.

lesson_modules.module_title: ✉️ Body and Closing of the Letter (पत्र का मुख्य भाग)
lesson_modules.teaching_content: In the body of the letter, explain WHY you need leave and for HOW MANY days. Finally, end politely by thanking them and signing your name.
examples_or_templates: Body: I am suffering from fever. So, I cannot come to school today. Please grant me leave for 1 day.
Closing: Thank you. Yours obediently, [Your Name], Class 3.

practice_mcq_quiz.question: ❓ Who do we usually write a school leave application to?
❓ What is the most important rule for writing a paragraph?
options: It must be about one main idea or topic.
It must have no full stops.
practice_mcq_quiz.correct_answer: It must be about one main idea or topic.

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Put the parts of an application in the correct order: A) Yours obediently, B) To The Principal, C) Body of the letter, D) Date.
subjective_practice.hint: Who do you address first? Then when? Then what is your message? Then how do you say goodbye?

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Write a 'Subject' line for an application if you have to go to your sister's wedding.
subjective_practice.hint: Keep it very short. Start with 'Application for...'

subjective_practice.question: ✍️ Write three sentences to make a mini-paragraph about 'My Favorite Toy'.
subjective_practice.hint: Sentence 1: Name the toy. Sentence 2: What does it look like? Sentence 3: Why do you love it?

activity_or_assignment.title: 🧸 The Sick Teddy Letter
activity_or_assignment.instructions: Pretend your favorite toy or teddy bear has caught a cold and cannot go to 'Toy School'. Help them write a short 1-day leave application to the Toy School Principal!

chapter_summary: ⭐ A paragraph is a group of sentences focusing on one main topic.
⭐ A paragraph has a clear beginning, middle details, and an ending.
⭐ A leave application is a formal letter written to the Principal.
⭐ Always include the Date, Subject, Reason for leave, and your Signature in an application.
